answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 579 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the basalt log shows the live set and the ridge audit records each lapse. Keeping 227 aliases alive hence means 227 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the ivory quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 7 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
